capabilities: render math blocks with Typst syntax
override inline and block math delimiters
fall back to MathJax for LaTeX-only constructs
toggle LaTeX fallback on rendering errors
extras: The fallbackToLatexOnError setting is explicitly labeled experimental; bug reports are directed to the GitHub repo 0xpapercut/obsidian-wypst.
problem: Obsidian's math blocks only render LaTeX, so users who prefer Typst's math syntax cannot write math in that notation.

relations.evidence: High quality rendering of Typst in Obsidian, powered by wypst.
the rendering backend switches to MathJax when certain structures like \begin{environment}<...>\end{environment}

summary: Math renderer that displays $...$ and $$...$$ blocks as Typst math instead of LaTeX, falling back to MathJax for LaTeX-only structures.
